findings.title: The batch-mode sentence asserts a baseline behaviour that does not exist and leaves a mid-walk shift to batch across sources unspecified
findings.recommendation: Delete 'as batch mode does today': the baseline states no batch-interruption behaviour (its only interruption rule is walk-mode's, between findings). State instead: an interrupted batch writes no log for any source whose log was not yet written. Add the mid-walk shift: a command-shaped switch to batch applies to the sources whose logs are not yet written, and the logs already written stand.

walk_entry.title: Per-source emission conflicts with invocation-wide batch semantics

findings.title: The clean-return scenario says the T0 record names no next step, contradicting the requirement it sits under
findings.recommendation: The T0 record still names the user action (paste, save), so 'names no next step' is false and a test built to it would assert an empty field. Rewrite the THEN as: the T0 record names no walk, and the eligibility line read after the return is saved names the in-context review. The WHEN also conflates T0 (before the return) with the completed pair: phrase it as a T0 emit for an external whose return will complete a clean pair.

walk_entry.title: The T0 handoff describes a walk where the engine can recommend verification

findings.title: The essential-redesign row's resolution column still describes a change returning to exploration on scopes that have no change
findings.recommendation: The routed_to cell now covers archived, project-wide and architecture walks, but the resolution cell beside it still reads 'the mechanism cannot leave the change ... and the change returns to exploration'. Qualify it: on an active change the change returns to exploration; elsewhere the mechanism goes to a new exploration and the finding stays escalated.

walk_entry.title: Essential-redesign routing assumes an active change in a command supporting other scopes

commentary: Seven of walk 2's ten resolutions landed clean, including the CRITICAL's descope: a rediscovered pass now re-records its closed findings stale, so nothing copied owes a sweep. The three regressions are all in the walk's own new sentences, at the edges of what each fix claimed: a baseline behaviour asserted without a read, a scenario wording that overshoots its requirement, and a table cell left beside the one that was edited. None adds mechanism; each is a wording repair. The residual check found no edit outside the walk's record.

direction.reasoning: The walk narrowed rather than invented, and what it left is wording, not mechanism. Repair the three in place and the proposal is ready to apply; another independent pass would be reviewing sentences, not design.
